say:1:1120501002:0.text: Where did it even come from?

say:2:1120501003:0.text: What are you staring at?! Run for your lives!

say:0:1120503001:0.source_cn: 又大又深的脚印……一定是只巨兽！

say:1:1120503002:0.text: No wonder why everyone was so terrified!

say:0:1120504001:0.text: These claw marks were left by some kind of beast...
say:0:1120504001:0.source_cn: 这些抓痕似乎是野兽留下的。
say:0:1120504001:0.male: These claw marks were left by some kind of beast...
say:0:1120504001:0.female: These claw marks were left by some kind of beast...

say:1:1120504002:0.text: We have to find that beast before it poses any danger to the villagers!
say:1:1120504002:0.source_cn: 我们得赶快找到它！不然镇民会有危险！

say:0:1120507001:0.text: Wait, Isn't that Koko and Patto?
say:0:1120507001:0.source_cn: 咦？那不是卡卡和帕托吗？

say:1:1120507002:0.text: What are they doing in Alkali? Hey!!! Koko!
say:1:1120507002:0.source_cn: 她们竟然来咸水镇了！\n嘿——卡卡！

say:1:1120508001:1.text: Koko, what brings you here? Listen, Alkali isn't the safest place to be right now! There's a giant beast lurking around the village!
say:1:1120508001:1.source_cn: 卡卡，你怎么自己一个人来咸水镇了？现在咸水镇乱糟糟的，...

say:2:1120508002:1.text: With Patto by my side, I'm not scared, not even one bit!

say:7:1120508005:1.text: Look at its fangs! RUN!!! I DON'T WANT TO BE EATEN ALIVE!!!
say:7:1120508005:1.source_cn: 它露出尖牙了！！快——快跑！不然会被吃掉！

choice_prompt:9:1120508005.text: Look at its fangs! RUN!!! I DON'T WANT TO BE EATEN ALIVE!!!
choice_prompt:9:1120508005.source_cn: 它露出尖牙了！！快——快跑！不然会被吃掉！

say:10:1120508006:5.text: Huh? Why are the villagers so scared? Patto and I didn't do anything...
say:10:1120508006:5.source_cn: 害怕？为什么？我和帕托什么也没做。

say:11:1120508007:1.text: Listen! I've just faced the scariest, most horrifying thing ever! It's gone! <style="highlight">The fabric store is gone</style>!
say:11:1120508007:1.source_cn: 最可怕最可怕的事在这里！不见了——<style=hig...

say:12:1120508008:1.text: Huh? The fabric store is on the other side of the village. We saw it on our way here!
say:12:1120508008:1.source_cn: 你在说什么呀，布料店就在镇子另一头呀，我们之前还路过过。

say:13:1120508009:1.text: But this map says it's right here!

say:14:1120508010:1.text: Look! I just have to walk past the stone houses, then turn here, turn there, and turn again...
say:14:1120508010:1.source_cn: 走过石头房子，转来转去，再转来转去……就到了这里！

choice_prompt:15:1120508010.text: Look! I just have to walk past the stone houses, then turn here, turn there, and turn again...
choice_prompt:15:1120508010.source_cn: 走过石头房子，转来转去，再转来转去……就到了这里！

say:16:1120508011:0.text: Upside down? What do you mean?

say:18:1120508012:1.text: Well... who would have thought? You stumbled upon Alkali by sheer luck, even with the map flipped!
say:18:1120508012:1.source_cn: 我看看……唔，确实是拿颠倒了。倒着看地图也能走到咸水镇...

choice_prompt:19:1120508012.text: Well... who would have thought? You stumbled upon Alkali by sheer luck, even with the map flipped!
choice_prompt:19:1120508012.source_cn: 我看看……唔，确实是拿颠倒了。倒着看地图也能走到咸水镇，真是奇迹呀！

say:20:1120508013:1.text: Hides! I need lots and lots of hides, and jars too! I need to bring these back to the clan, everyone's been waiting for them!
say:20:1120508013:1.source_cn: 毛皮！很多很多毛皮，还有陶罐！更多陶罐！要给部落，大家...

say:21:1120508014:1.text: Many people are injured! Hunting's off the table!
say:21:1120508014:1.source_cn: 很多人，受伤了！没办法捕猎。

say:22:1120508015:1.text: So, I'm here because Satrana told me to buy things! I can't let her and Antandra down!
say:22:1120508015:1.source_cn: 所以，萨忒娜告诉我来买东西！我不能让她和安丹姐失望！

say:26:1120508017:1.text: Was that a happy roar or an angry roar...?
say:26:1120508017:1.source_cn: 帕托是在赞同……还是在生气？

say:27:1120508018:1.text: He's a bit nervous. This is his first time here!
say:27:1120508018:1.source_cn: 帕托紧张。这里，帕托第一次来！

say:28:1120508019:1.text: Don't be scared, Patto. I'll always be by your side!

say:30:1120508020:1.text: Thankfully, we found you in time, so there wasn't a big fuss in the town. Let us take you to the fabric store!
say:30:1120508020:1.source_cn: 幸好我们及时找到了你们，没有在镇里搞出大骚动来。就让我...

choice:19:1:2.text: Why are you looking for the fabric store?
choice:19:1:2.male: Why are you looking for the fabric store?
choice:19:1:2.female: Why are you looking for the fabric store?

choice:15:0:1.text: You sure your map isn't upside down?
choice:15:0:1.male: You sure your map isn't upside down?
choice:15:0:1.female: You sure your map isn't upside down?

choice:9:0:1.source_cn: 原来镇民说的巨大野兽是帕托！

choice:9:1:2.text: Koko was the one causing all the fuss...
choice:9:1:2.source_cn: 原来让咸水镇人心惶惶的是卡卡！
choice:9:1:2.male: Koko was the one causing all the fuss...
choice:9:1:2.female: Koko was the one causing all the fuss...

say:1:1120509001:1.text: Hey, that big guy following behind you looks quite strong! He must be the one causing the commotion in town!
say:1:1120509001:1.source_cn: 呀，小丫头，你身后跟着的这大家伙，够壮实！镇上的骚动肯...

say:2:1120509002:1.text: How much did you spend to get him? He probably wasn't cheap, huh? I heard that the <style="highlight">auction</style> is full of shills driving up the prices.
say:2:1120509002:1.source_cn: 你花了多少钱才拿下它？估计不便宜吧，听说那<style...

say:4:1120509004:1.text: You don't know? Then forget what I said.
say:4:1120509004:1.source_cn: 不知道？那就别在意，当我没说。

say:5:1120509005:1.text: Come take a look at the hides! All acquired in the past couple of days, and I guarantee the quality is top-notch!
say:5:1120509005:1.source_cn: 还是来看看我家的兽皮吧！都是我这两天新收的，质量绝对没的说！

say:6:1120509006:1.text: I want the big ones! Antandra said one has to be as big as a tent! Hmmm... I need fifty of them!
say:6:1120509006:1.source_cn: 要，长毛的！安丹姐说……嗯，要帐篷那么大，五十张！

say:7:1120509007:1.text: That's quite a bulk order. Let me check if I have enough in stock at the store.
say:7:1120509007:1.source_cn: 这量可不小啊，等我算算店里这些够不够。

say:9:1120509008:1.text: Hey, guess what? I happen to have exactly fifty hides!
say:9:1120509008:1.source_cn: 哟，正正好！卖完你这五十张，我这儿就只剩几张边角料了。

say:10:1120509009:1.text: Let me just do the math... Okay, considering the bulk purchase, I'll knock off 10% and round down... Two hundred gold coins! Cash or trade-in, your choice?
say:10:1120509009:1.source_cn: 让我算一下总价……嗯，你要了这么多，打个九折再抹零……...

choice_prompt:11:1120509009.text: Let me just do the math... Okay, considering the bulk purchase, I'll knock off 10% and round down... Two hundred gold coins! Cash or trade-in, your choice?
choice_prompt:11:1120509009.source_cn: 让我算一下总价……嗯，你要了这么多，打个九折再抹零……就这个数吧，两百枚金币！现金还是拿东西抵押？

say:12:1120509010:2.text: That's outrageous! Four gold coins for just one hide...
say:12:1120509010:2.source_cn: 就是啊，一张毛皮居然要四枚金币……！

say:13:1120509013:1.text: Ah, you folks clearly don't know quality when you see it. A hide this sturdy is a steal at four gold coins.
say:13:1120509013:1.source_cn: 唉，一看你们就不识货。这么结实的兽皮，卖四金币都算便宜的。

say:14:1120509014:1.text: Plus, you're not even the ones paying! Let the smart girl here figure things out! I'm sure she knows this is a good deal!
say:14:1120509014:1.source_cn: 再说了，又不是你们付钱，小丫头还在算呢。这价格，你们不吃亏！

say:15:1120509015:1.text: Hmmm, Antandra gave me four hundred for two things... and half of four hundred is two hundred...
say:15:1120509015:1.source_cn: 唔，安丹姐给了四百，要买两样东西……四百的一半是两百……

say:16:1120509016:1.text: That's exactly half! I can totally get these hides!

choice_prompt:17:1120509016.text: That's exactly half! I can totally get these hides!

say:19:1120509020:1.text: Don't worry! Leave the bargaining to me and <style="stress"><player_name></style>!
say:19:1120509020:1.source_cn: 不用担心，砍价的事就包在我和<style=stress...
say:19:1120509020:1.male: Don't worry! Leave the bargaining to me and <style="stress"><player_name></style>!
say:19:1120509020:1.female: Don't worry! Leave the bargaining to me and <style="stress"><player_name></style>!

choice:17:0:1.text: Hold on, the price can be lower.
choice:17:0:1.source_cn: 先别答应，价格还能更低
choice:17:0:1.male: Hold on, the price can be lower.
choice:17:0:1.female: Hold on, the price can be lower.

choice:17:1:2.text: You need to budget enough to buy jars!
choice:17:1:2.male: You need to budget enough to buy jars!
choice:17:1:2.female: You need to budget enough to buy jars!

say:23:1120509011:1.text: Well, here's Alkali, not everyone carries that much gold around.
say:23:1120509011:1.source_cn: 这里是咸水镇，你不能指望每个人身上都随身带着那么多钱。
say:23:1120509011:1.male: Well, here's Alkali, not everyone carries that much gold around.
say:23:1120509011:1.female: Well, here's Alkali, not everyone carries that much gold around.

say:24:1120509012:2.text: Hold on, that's not the point! Four gold coins for one hide is just too pricey!
say:24:1120509012:2.source_cn: 重点不是这个啦！一张毛皮要四枚金币，这个价格是不是……

say:1:1120509501:1.text: Such fine hides for just two hundred gold coins is an absolute steal!
say:1:1120509501:1.source_cn: 这么好的兽皮，五十张才卖你两百金币！简直是物美价廉！
say:1:1120509501:1.male: Such fine hides for just two hundred gold coins is an absolute steal!
say:1:1120509501:1.female: Such fine hides for just two hundred gold coins is an absolute steal!

choice_prompt:2:1120509501.text: Such fine hides for just two hundred gold coins is an absolute steal!
choice_prompt:2:1120509501.source_cn: 这么好的兽皮，五十张才卖你两百金币！简直是物美价廉！
choice_prompt:2:1120509501.male: Such fine hides for just two hundred gold coins is an absolute steal!
choice_prompt:2:1120509501.female: Such fine hides for just two hundred gold coins is an absolute steal!

say:3:1120509502:1.text: Fifty?! Don't be ridiculous! If you can find someone selling at that price, go ahead and ask them.
say:3:1120509502:1.source_cn: ——五十金币？！别开玩笑了，真卖不了！谁要是能卖这个价...
say:3:1120509502:1.male: Fifty?! Don't be ridiculous! If you can find someone selling at that price, go ahead and ask them.
say:3:1120509502:1.female: Fifty?! Don't be ridiculous! If you can find someone selling at that price, go ahead and ask them.

say:4:1120509504:1.text: The quality of my hides doesn't warrant such a drastic reduction!
say:4:1120509504:1.source_cn: 我家兽皮可是镇上最好的，不能随便降价！

choice_prompt:5:1120509504.text: The quality of my hides doesn't warrant such a drastic reduction!
choice_prompt:5:1120509504.source_cn: 我家兽皮可是镇上最好的，不能随便降价！

say:6:1120509505:1.text: Sir, you're putting me in a tight spot here. No hide, no matter how durable, lasts for ten years.
say:6:1120509505:1.male: Sir, you're putting me in a tight spot here. No hide, no matter how durable, lasts for ten years.
say:6:1120509505:1.female: Miss, you're putting me in a tight spot here. No hide, no matter how durable, lasts for ten years.

say:7:1120509507:1.text: Even if these hides are used for tents and exposed to wind and sun every day, as long as no one damages them, they should last three or four years without any problem.
say:7:1120509507:1.source_cn: 不过你放心，这些兽皮哪怕是拿来搭帐篷，天天风吹日晒，但...
say:7:1120509507:1.male: Even if these hides are used for tents and exposed to wind and sun every day, as long as no one damages them, they should last three or four years without any problem.
say:7:1120509507:1.female: Even if these hides are used for tents and exposed to wind and sun every day, as long as no one damages them, they should last three or four years without any problem.

choice_prompt:8:1120509507.text: Even if these hides are used for tents and exposed to wind and sun every day, as long as no one damages them, they should last three or four years without any problem.
choice_prompt:8:1120509507.source_cn: 不过你放心，这些兽皮哪怕是拿来搭帐篷，天天风吹日晒，但只要没有人为破坏，用个三四年还是不成问题的。
choice_prompt:8:1120509507.male: Even if these hides are used for tents and exposed to wind and sun every day, as long as no one damages them, they should last three or four years without any problem.
choice_prompt:8:1120509507.female: Even if these hides are used for tents and exposed to wind and sun every day, as long as no one damages them, they should last three or four years without any problem.

say:9:1120509508:1.text: Yikes, can't blame me for that. This place is scorching hot during the day, and freezing cold at night.
say:9:1120509508:1.source_cn: 哟，这你可不能怪我。这地方就是这样，白天热得满脑门汗，...
say:9:1120509508:1.male: Yikes, can't blame me for that. This place is scorching hot during the day, and freezing cold at night.
say:9:1120509508:1.female: Yikes, can't blame me for that. This place is scorching hot during the day, and freezing cold at night.

say:10:1120509510:1.text: I'm the most respected hide dealer in town, I never skimp on quality.
say:10:1120509510:1.source_cn: 我布狄卡可是镇上信誉最好的皮货商人，绝对不会偷工减料的。

choice_prompt:11:1120509510.text: I'm the most respected hide dealer in town, I never skimp on quality.
choice_prompt:11:1120509510.source_cn: 我布狄卡可是镇上信誉最好的皮货商人，绝对不会偷工减料的。

say:12:1120509511:1.text: *Sigh* Like I said, this is the lowest price...
say:12:1120509511:1.source_cn: 呀……我都说了，这已经是最低价了……

say:13:1120509514:1.text: Alright... 140 gold coins! I can't go any lower than that!
say:13:1120509514:1.source_cn: 这样吧……一百四十枚金币！绝对不能再低了！

choice_prompt:14:1120509514.text: Alright... 140 gold coins! I can't go any lower than that!
choice_prompt:14:1120509514.source_cn: 这样吧……一百四十枚金币！绝对不能再低了！

say:15:1120509515:1.text: Fine, fine... Take them! As they say, the best bargainers make the best deals... If you ever make it big in business, don't forget about me!
say:15:1120509515:1.source_cn: ……行吧行吧！你们拿走吧！俗话说得好，越是会砍价的人越...
say:15:1120509515:1.male: Fine, fine... Take them! As they say, the best bargainers make the best deals... If you ever make it big in business, don't forget about me!
say:15:1120509515:1.female: Fine, fine... Take them! As they say, the best bargainers make the best deals... If you ever make it big in business, don't forget about me!

choice:11:0:1.text: What's the lowest price you'll take?
choice:11:0:1.source_cn: 我诚心想要，给个最低价！
choice:11:0:1.male: What's the lowest price you'll take?
choice:11:0:1.female: What's the lowest price you'll take?

say:17:1120509512:1.text: I really can't make it any cheaper...
say:17:1120509512:1.source_cn: 哎呀，我给的优惠已经很多了！

choice:11:1:2.text: C'mon, give a bit more discount!
choice:11:1:2.source_cn: 这单可是大生意，再多给点优惠！
choice:11:1:2.male: C'mon, give a bit more discount!
choice:11:1:2.female: C'mon, give a bit more discount!

say:18:1120509513:1.text: Then you mustn't go back on your word!
say:18:1120509513:1.male: Then you mustn't go back on your word!
say:18:1120509513:1.female: Then you mustn't go back on your word!

choice:11:2:3.text: I'll bring you more customers in the future!
choice:11:2:3.source_cn: 打个折，以后我给你推荐客人！
choice:11:2:3.male: I'll bring you more customers in the future!
choice:11:2:3.female: I'll bring you more customers in the future!

choice:8:0:1.text: It's too warm during the day for this.
choice:8:0:1.source_cn: 毛这么长，白天肯定很热
choice:8:0:1.male: It's too warm during the day for this.
choice:8:0:1.female: It's too warm during the day for this.

say:19:1120509509:1.text: No... No way! It's because you're standing too far away from them!
say:19:1120509509:1.source_cn: 哪……哪有啊！是你站得太靠边了，所以才觉得看起来有点小。
say:19:1120509509:1.male: No... No way! It's because you're standing too far away from them!
say:19:1120509509:1.female: No... No way! It's because you're standing too far away from them!

choice:8:1:2.text: They're too small for making tents.
choice:8:1:2.source_cn: 这些兽皮的尺寸比帐篷小不少啊
choice:8:1:2.male: They're too small for making tents.
choice:8:1:2.female: They're too small for making tents.

choice:5:0:1.text: Can they last for more than ten years?
choice:5:0:1.male: Can they last for more than ten years?
choice:5:0:1.female: Can they last for more than ten years?

say:20:1120509506:1.text: Hey hey hey, this won't do! If this big guy takes a swipe at it, even the best hide won't hold up!
say:20:1120509506:1.source_cn: 哎哎哎——这可不行！这大家伙要是来上一爪子，多好的兽皮...

choice:5:1:2.text: Shall we have Patto test its durability?
choice:5:1:2.source_cn: 卡卡，让帕托试试结不结实！
choice:5:1:2.male: Shall we have Patto test its durability?
choice:5:1:2.female: Shall we have Patto test its durability?

choice:2:0:1.text: Fifty, take it or leave it.
choice:2:0:1.male: Fifty, take it or leave it.
choice:2:0:1.female: Fifty, take it or leave it.

say:21:1120509503:1.source_cn: 这……这也太少了！哪有你这样砍价的！

choice:2:1:2.text: A hundred, take it or leave it.
choice:2:1:2.source_cn: 一百金币，多一个也不行
choice:2:1:2.male: A hundred, take it or leave it.
choice:2:1:2.female: A hundred, take it or leave it.

say:0:1120510001:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, that was amazing! We saved a lot of money!
say:0:1120510001:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, that was amazing! We saved a lot of money!
say:0:1120510001:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, that was amazing! We saved a lot of money!

say:1:1120510002:0.text: Impressive, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Slashing the price this much leaves us with enough money for loads of jars!
say:1:1120510002:0.male: Impressive, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Slashing the price this much leaves us with enough money for loads of jars!
say:1:1120510002:0.female: Impressive, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Slashing the price this much leaves us with enough money for loads of jars!

say:2:1120510003:0.text: The pottery shop is down south on the street. Let's head over there.
say:2:1120510003:0.source_cn: 记得陶制品的小铺在南边的街上，我们过去吧。
say:2:1120510003:0.male: The pottery shop is down south on the street. Let's head over there.
say:2:1120510003:0.female: The pottery shop is down south on the street. Let's head over there.

say:1:1120511001:1.text: I'm busy right now, but feel free to pick out what you need. The prices are all the same.
say:1:1120511001:1.source_cn: 我正忙，东西自己挑就行，价格都一样。

say:2:1120511002:1.text: Oh dear, we need a large batch of supplies for rebuilding the clan.
say:2:1120511002:1.source_cn: 哎呀，我们要很大一批货，要给部落重建用的。

say:3:1120511003:1.text: Whoa, sounds like you're talking about a major deal.
say:3:1120511003:1.source_cn: 哟，听你这口气，可是单大生意啊。

say:4:1120511004:1.text: Alright, how much do you need? Let's hear it.
say:4:1120511004:1.source_cn: 那行吧，你们要多少，说来听——

say:9:1120511008:1.text: AGH! W-what's wrong with this beast?!
say:9:1120511008:1.source_cn: 哇——！！这、这野兽是怎么回事？！

say:12:1120511009:2.text: Oh no! Patto... Patto's gone mad!

choice_prompt:13:1120511009.text: Oh no! Patto... Patto's gone mad!

say:14:1120511010:1.text: Patto has never been so angry!
say:14:1120511010:1.source_cn: 帕托，从来没有这么生气！

say:15:1120511011:1.text: Patto, look at me! What's wrong?

say:16:1120511012:1.text: Does he have any favorite treats? Maybe seeing his favorite food will calm him down!
say:16:1120511012:1.source_cn: 那、那它有没有什么特别爱吃的东西？也许看到喜欢的食物，...

say:19:1120511014:2.text: Especially the ones that grow in the oasis!
say:19:1120511014:2.source_cn: 尤其是，长在绿洲的旅人树果！帕托最喜欢！

say:20:1120511015:1.text: Got it! We'll get right on it!

choice:13:0:1.text: Koko, can you calm him down?
choice:13:0:1.male: Koko, can you calm him down?
choice:13:0:1.female: Koko, can you calm him down?

say:0:1120511201:0.text: The oasis near Alkali should have wanderfruit.
say:0:1120511201:0.source_cn: 咸水镇附近的绿洲应该就有旅人树果。

say:1:1120511202:0.text: It's not far from here, so we can return quickly!
say:1:1120511202:0.source_cn: 那里离得也不远，很快就能回来！

say:0:1120511501:0.text: These should be enough! Let's hurry back to Koko and Patto!
say:0:1120511501:0.source_cn: 这些旅人树果应该就够了！我们赶快回去，拿给卡卡和帕托吧。

say:1:1120512001:0.text: Look, Patto! We brought your favorite wanderfruit!
say:1:1120512001:0.source_cn: 帕托你看，你最喜欢的旅人树果！

say:3:1120512003:0.text: Doesn't seem to work... Why would Patto suddenly become so aggressive? Aren't hornleaf bears supposed to be gentle creatures?
say:3:1120512003:0.source_cn: 唉，完全没用……帕托为什么会突然这么暴躁？叶角熊不是应...

say:5:1120512004:1.text: Hold on, you're saying this huge beast here is a hornleaf bear?! How did he grow this big?!
say:5:1120512004:1.source_cn: 等等，这只野兽是叶角熊？！竟然能长到这么大？！

choice_prompt:6:1120512004.text: Hold on, you're saying this huge beast here is a hornleaf bear?! How did he grow this big?!
choice_prompt:6:1120512004.source_cn: 等等，这只野兽是叶角熊？！竟然能长到这么大？！

say:7:1120512005:0.text: A year ago, when I used to hunt around, I bought a little hornleaf bear from the <style="highlight">auction</style> to train as my hunting partner.
say:7:1120512005:0.source_cn: 一年前，我还四处捕猎的时候，从<style=highl...

say:8:1120512006:1.text: But he managed to escape when I wasn't looking.
say:8:1120512006:1.source_cn: 不过后来它趁我不注意，撞开笼门逃跑了。

say:9:1120512007:1.text: I thought he wouldn't survive in the Eroded Enclave, so I didn't bother looking for him. I never thought you folks would find him.
say:9:1120512007:1.source_cn: 我以为没人饲养，它在风蚀飞地活不下来，就没去找，没想到...

choice_prompt:10:1120512007.text: I thought he wouldn't survive in the Eroded Enclave, so I didn't bother looking for him. I never thought you folks would find him.
choice_prompt:10:1120512007.source_cn: 我以为没人饲养，它在风蚀飞地活不下来，就没去找，没想到居然是被你们捡走了。

say:11:1120512008:1.text: Easy there, I'm not asking you to give him back. I've switched to selling goods, I don't need a hunting partner anymore.
say:11:1120512008:1.male: Easy there, I'm not asking you to give him back. I've switched to selling goods, I don't need a hunting partner anymore.
say:11:1120512008:1.female: Easy there, I'm not asking you to give him back. I've switched to selling goods, I don't need a hunting partner anymore.

say:12:1120512009:1.text: But hey, I paid a hefty sum. Shouldn't you give me...
say:12:1120512009:1.source_cn: 不过，当初买它，我可是花了大价钱。这部分价钱我们是不是——

say:13:1120512010:1.text: I don't like you! You abused Patto!

say:14:1120512011:1.text: You locked him up and didn't give him food!
say:14:1120512011:1.source_cn: 你……你把它关在笼子里！还不给它吃东西！

say:15:1120512012:0.text: Patto was skinny and had a flat belly when I found him! I gave him lots and lots of fruit, but he was still hungry! He even threw up!
say:15:1120512012:0.source_cn: 帕托来时……瘦瘦小小，肚子也扁扁的！我给它找了好多好多...

say:16:1120512013:0.text: You're the one that made Patto suffer so much!
say:16:1120512013:0.source_cn: 都是你！害得帕托受了好多苦！

say:19:1120512015:1.text: That wasn't my fault! The auction staff taught me the taming methods!
say:19:1120512015:1.source_cn: 这……这不能怪我！是拍卖会工作人员教我的驯养方法！

say:20:1120512016:0.text: They said hornleaf bears were naturally aggressive, and suggested starvation and controlled feeding to enforce loyalty and obedience.
say:20:1120512016:0.source_cn: 他们说叶角熊生性凶残，想让它乖乖听话就必须保持饥饿，控...

say:22:1120512017:0.text: They told me not to feed him too much. Otherwise, he'll get so fat that he won't be able to walk. How was I supposed to know he was starving?
say:22:1120512017:0.source_cn: 还说不能喂食太多，否则它会胖得连路都走不了。我……我哪...

choice_prompt:23:1120512017.text: They told me not to feed him too much. Otherwise, he'll get so fat that he won't be able to walk. How was I supposed to know he was starving?
choice_prompt:23:1120512017.source_cn: 还说不能喂食太多，否则它会胖得连路都走不了。我……我哪知道它一直没吃饱啊？！

say:24:1120512018:1.text: I attended the auction a year ago, the Adamant Syndicate held it in a cave behind the market, specifically to sell rare animals from other places.

say:25:1120512019:1.text: The old venue collapsed due to earthquakes. They've moved to a more hidden spot, I hear it's in <style="highlight">a cave west of town</style>.
say:25:1120512019:1.source_cn: 最近地震太频繁，原来的会场倒塌了，他们就换了个更隐蔽的...

say:27:1120512020:1.text: Did you buy any more animals?!

say:28:1120512021:1.text: I've quit hunting altogether. The Adamant Syndicate asks for such high prices. What's the use of buying animals that are only good for display and don't yield any profit?
say:28:1120512021:1.source_cn: 没有啊！我都不干捕猎这一行了，黑金商会要价那么高，不能...

say:29:1120512022:1.text: Only those who give the correct code are allowed in. I don't mind telling you, but it all depends on how much you're willing to pay me!
say:29:1120512022:1.source_cn: 你们要去的话，他们有个规矩，只允许<style=hig...

choice_prompt:30:1120512022.text: Only those who give the correct code are allowed in. I don't mind telling you, but it all depends on how much you're willing to pay me!
choice_prompt:30:1120512022.source_cn: 你们要去的话，他们有个规矩，只允许<style=highlight>对上暗号的人</style>进入会场。至于暗号嘛……就看你们能给我开多高的价了！

say:31:1120512023:1.text: Patto, teach this bad guy a lesson!

say:34:1120512025:1.text: Hold on! Don't let him wreck my stall! These are all newly imported goods!
say:34:1120512025:1.source_cn: 等、等一下！别让它砸我的摊子！这都是新进的货啊！

say:35:1120512026:1.text: Fine, you guys win. Alright... the code is <style="stress">"In the eroded cave, lie the treasures in wait"</style>.
say:35:1120512026:1.source_cn: 算你们厉害，是我倒霉，我认栽。好吧……暗号是<styl...

say:36:1120512027:1.text: Play it cool when the guards stop you at the entrance. Once they say the first part of the code, you follow up with the second part.
say:36:1120512027:1.source_cn: 入场之前，会有守卫拦下你们盘问的。他说完第一句，你们接...

choice_prompt:37:1120512027.text: Play it cool when the guards stop you at the entrance. Once they say the first part of the code, you follow up with the second part.
choice_prompt:37:1120512027.source_cn: 入场之前，会有守卫拦下你们盘问的。他说完第一句，你们接上第二句就行。

say:38:1120512028:1.text: I've told you everything I know. If you don't trust me, go ahead and force your way in. There's always a way to get in.
say:38:1120512028:1.source_cn: 唉，我是能说的都说了，你们要是信不过我就硬闯，总有进去...

say:39:1120512029:1.text: Just remember, if things go sideways, keep my name out of it! I plan on sticking around Alkali for a few more years.
say:39:1120512029:1.source_cn: 只不过，不管你们闹出什么事来，别说是我把暗号告诉你们的...

choice:37:0:1.source_cn: 希望你是一个正直诚实的人

choice:37:1:2.text: Don't you dare lie to us!
choice:37:1:2.male: Don't you dare lie to us!
choice:37:1:2.female: Don't you dare lie to us!

choice:30:0:1.text: You want a fight that bad?
choice:30:0:1.source_cn: 不怕受到人身伤害的话，尽管要钱
choice:30:0:1.male: You want a fight that bad?
choice:30:0:1.female: You want a fight that bad?

choice:30:1:2.text: We won't pay you a single penny!
choice:30:1:2.male: We won't pay you a single penny!
choice:30:1:2.female: We won't pay you a single penny!

choice:30:2:3.source_cn: 你到底是做什么生意的？！

choice:10:2:3.text: Don't even think about getting him back!
choice:10:2:3.source_cn: 休想让我们把帕托还给你！
choice:10:2:3.male: Don't even think about getting him back!
choice:10:2:3.female: Don't even think about getting him back!

say:0:1120514001:0.text: This must be where the auction is held!

say:1:1120514002:0.text: Remember, the code is "In the eroded cave, lie the treasures in wait"!
say:1:1120514002:0.source_cn: 我们赶快去找守卫对暗号吧！暗号是：风蚀残谷，咸水珍奇！

say:4:1120516005:1.text: Hmph, you got it right. But you can't just waltz in like that!
say:4:1120516005:1.source_cn: 哼……看来还真是客人。\n不过，你们不能就这样进去！

say:6:1120516006:1.text: Why not? We told you the correct code!
say:6:1120516006:1.source_cn: 为什么？我们刚才明明已经答上暗号了！

say:7:1120516007:1.text: That huge bear can't go in!
say:7:1120516007:1.source_cn: 因为这小孩带的大块头！那头熊不能进会场。

say:10:1120516009:1.text: If that huge beast goes berserk and causes chaos, I'll lose my job!
say:10:1120516009:1.source_cn: 这么大的野兽，万一发起怒来，惹乱了会场秩序，我的工钱就...

say:11:1120516010:1.text: These two little rats can go in.
say:11:1120516010:1.source_cn: 这两只老鼠。个头小，没问题。

say:15:1120516003:2.text: No... The right answer is <style="stress">"Lie the treasures in wait"</style>!

say:16:1120516004:2.text: I know! I know! In the eroded cave, lie the treasures in wait!
say:16:1120516004:2.source_cn: 我知道——！风蚀残谷，咸水珍奇！

choice:3:2:3.source_cn: 让我的使魔来回答这个问题

say:0:1120518001:0.text: What do we do now? We can't get into the auction...
say:0:1120518001:0.source_cn: 这下可怎么办？我们进不去拍卖会了……

say:1:1120518002:0.text: Hmmm... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, let's discuss it with Koko.
say:1:1120518002:0.male: Hmmm... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, let's discuss it with Koko.
say:1:1120518002:0.female: Hmmm... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, let's discuss it with Koko.

say:1:1120519001:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Patto has to go in! Patto has to teach those bad guys a lesson!
say:1:1120519001:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Patto has to go in! Patto has to teach those bad guys a lesson!
say:1:1120519001:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Patto has to go in! Patto has to teach those bad guys a lesson!

say:2:1120519002:1.text: Don't worry, Koko. The magister will think of something!
say:2:1120519002:1.source_cn: 卡卡，你别着急，主人肯定会想出办法的！
say:2:1120519002:1.male: Don't worry, Koko. The magister will think of something!
say:2:1120519002:1.female: Don't worry, Koko. The magister will think of something!

choice_prompt:3:1120519002.text: Don't worry, Koko. The magister will think of something!
choice_prompt:3:1120519002.source_cn: 卡卡，你别着急，主人肯定会想出办法的！
choice_prompt:3:1120519002.male: Don't worry, Koko. The magister will think of something!
choice_prompt:3:1120519002.female: Don't worry, Koko. The magister will think of something!

say:4:1120519003:1.text: Aha! That way, Patto can enter the venue!
say:4:1120519003:1.source_cn: 对哦，这样帕托就可以进入拍卖会了！

say:5:1120519004:1.text: Then we would have to find an unlocked cage, let Patto in, and move it to the backstage...
say:5:1120519004:1.source_cn: 如果用这个办法，得做一些伪装。比如找来不上锁的笼子，让...

say:6:1120519005:1.text: No! Patto is not an item for sale!

say:7:1120519006:1.text: Even if he's just faking to be one! No means no!
say:7:1120519006:1.source_cn: 就算是假的，也不是商品！只有这件事，我不答应！

say:11:1120519009:0.text: Oh, I have an idea! Patto, go!

choice:3:0:1.text: Patto could act as an animal for auction.
choice:3:0:1.source_cn: 让帕托扮成要被拍卖的动物？
choice:3:0:1.male: Patto could act as an animal for auction.
choice:3:0:1.female: Patto could act as an animal for auction.

say:0:1120520001:0.text: Hey, where did Patto run off to?

say:1:1120520002:0.text: Don't worry! Patto knows what he's doing!
say:1:1120520002:0.source_cn: 不用担心！帕托知道该怎么做！

say:3:1120520004:0.text: Let's go to the auction now!

say:3:1120522001:1.text: These birds look so familiar... Have we seen them before?
say:3:1120522001:1.source_cn: 这些鸟看着好眼熟……咱们是不是在哪里见过？

say:4:1120522002:1.text: These are <style="highlight">waterfowls from the Remnant Peaks</style>! I remember seeing them by the lakes near the Moon Temple!

say:5:1120522003:1.text: Their natural habitat is nothing like the Eroded Enclave, yet the Adamant Syndicate transported them here. How will they manage to survive?
say:5:1120522003:1.source_cn: 明明是水鸟，却被黑金商会运到风蚀飞地来！它们栖息的环境...

say:7:1120522005:1.text: Not yet, I just overheard a Syndicate member saying that the waterfowls we see here are only a small fraction of them.
say:7:1120522005:1.source_cn: 现在还不行，刚才看黑金的工作人员说，现在场内看到的水鸟...

say:8:1120522006:1.text: Let's wait a bit longer, Koko. We must rescue all the waterfowls in one go.
say:8:1120522006:1.source_cn: 再多等一会儿吧，卡卡，我们必须一口气把所有水鸟都救出来。

choice_prompt:9:1120522006.text: Let's wait a bit longer, Koko. We must rescue all the waterfowls in one go.
choice_prompt:9:1120522006.source_cn: 再多等一会儿吧，卡卡，我们必须一口气把所有水鸟都救出来。

say:10:1120522007:1.text: Well, let's look around and investigate!
say:10:1120522007:1.source_cn: 嗯，我们就趁这个机会，四处调查一下吧！

choice:9:1:2.text: There are too many guards here.
choice:9:1:2.source_cn: 这里守卫太多了，也得想想办法
choice:9:1:2.male: There are too many guards here.
choice:9:1:2.female: There are too many guards here.

say:0:1120524001:0.text: The cries of the waterfowls are truly distressing, poor things...
say:0:1120524001:0.source_cn: 水鸟叫得真惨烈，好可怜啊……

say:1:1120524002:0.text: There are Syndicate guards here, let's check elsewhere.
say:1:1120524002:0.source_cn: 这里有黑金的人看守，其他地方呢？
say:1:1120524002:0.male: There are Syndicate guards here, let's check elsewhere.
say:1:1120524002:0.female: There are Syndicate guards here, let's check elsewhere.

say:0:1120526001:0.text: How strange, there are beds here... Do the Adamant Syndicate members live here?
say:0:1120526001:0.source_cn: 真奇怪，这里还有地铺和陶罐……难道黑金那些人平时也住在这里？

say:1:1120526002:0.text: Probably. A setup like this auction requires a fair amount of manpower.
say:1:1120526002:0.source_cn: 应该是。这种拍卖会需要不少人力来准备。
say:1:1120526002:0.male: Probably. A setup like this auction requires a fair amount of manpower.
say:1:1120526002:0.female: Probably. A setup like this auction requires a fair amount of manpower.

say:0:1120527001:0.text: Falcons, gleamtails...?! How many creatures have they captured and sold?!
say:0:1120527001:0.source_cn: 游隼、荧尾鼠……？！黑金到底在这里举办过多少次拍卖会，...

say:1:1120527002:0.text: The Adamant Syndicate has already brought in all the waterfowls, and the auction is about to start. But... how can we save them?
say:1:1120527002:0.source_cn: 黑金已经把水鸟都搬进来了，拍卖会马上就开始。可是……我...

say:0:1120530001:0.text: Now! Let's go free the waterfowls!
say:0:1120530001:0.source_cn: 呼，趁现在，我们去把水鸟放出来吧！

say:1:1120530002:0.text: They shouldn't be tied up like this!

say:1:1120531001:1.text: Great! The waterfowls are all out of their cages!
say:1:1120531001:1.source_cn: 鸟儿都不在笼子里了，真好！

say:2:1120531002:1.text: Phew, that was close! Luckily, Patto barging into the auction caught the Adamant Syndicate off guard, they didn't have time to react!
say:2:1120531002:1.source_cn: 好险！还好帕托突然闯入拍卖会场，这才让黑金措手不及，来...

say:3:1120531003:1.text: Chippy was caught off guard too!
say:3:1120531003:1.source_cn: 满满也完全没有准备，被吓了一跳呢！

say:4:1120531004:1.text: Patto and I make a great hunting team!
say:4:1120531004:1.source_cn: 帕托和我抓猎物时，配合很好！

say:5:1120531005:1.text: I rush out, he blocks the way! He always understands my signals!
say:5:1120531005:1.source_cn: 一个冲出去，一个去堵路！它能明白我的意思！

say:10:1120531008:1.text: Patto feels sorry for the waterfowls...

say:12:1120531009:1.text: These cages are the worst! They're leaving the waterfowls hungry and trapped!
say:12:1120531009:1.source_cn: 笼子，讨厌！没东西吃，讨厌！不能回家，非常讨厌！！

say:13:1120531010:1.text: These waterbirds are originally from the Remnant Peaks, where the environment is mild and humid, completely different from the hot and dry Eroded Enclave.
say:13:1120531010:1.source_cn: 这些水鸟的原生地在遗迹群山，那里的环境温和潮湿，和酷热...

say:14:1120531011:1.text: Unlike hornleaf bears, they have poor adaptability, and enduring the journey here likely strained their bodies.
say:14:1120531011:1.source_cn: 它们和叶角熊不一样，适应力很差，一路颠簸来到这里，估计...

say:15:1120531012:1.text: No, they can't stay here! They'll suffer even more than Patto!
say:15:1120531012:1.source_cn: ……不，它们不能留在这里！会比帕托更可怜！

say:16:1120531013:1.text: Can you take them back where they belong?
say:16:1120531013:1.source_cn: 你们知道它们原来在哪里？拜托，送它们回家！

say:19:1120531015:3.text: Rest assured, Koko, we'll ensure these waterfowls are returned to their home. It's a knight's pledge!
say:19:1120531015:3.source_cn: 放心吧，卡卡，我们一定会把这些水鸟送回家，这是骑士的诺言！

say:22:1120531017:1.text: You're nice! We like you! Very very much!
say:22:1120531017:1.source_cn: 你们是大好人！帕托和卡卡，喜欢你们！

say:23:1120531018:1.text: Patto, are you happy? Everybody has been set free!
say:23:1120531018:1.source_cn: 笑吧，帕托！自由了！大家都自由了！

choice:18:0:1.text: Don't worry, leave it to me.
choice:18:0:1.male: Don't worry, leave it to me.
choice:18:0:1.female: Don't worry, leave it to me.

say:1:1120532002:0.text: Let's set the waterfowls free here.
say:1:1120532002:0.male: Let's set the waterfowls free here.
say:1:1120532002:0.female: Let's set the waterfowls free here.

say:0:1120533001:0.text: Fly! Fly freely in the sky!

say:1:1120533002:0.text: Clearly, they are happier at the Remnant Peaks!
say:1:1120533002:0.source_cn: 果然还是遗迹群山最适宜它们！

say:2:1120533003:0.text: The free spirits have finally returned home.
say:2:1120533003:0.source_cn: 自由的生灵，终于重回故乡了。
say:2:1120533003:0.male: The free spirits have finally returned home.
say:2:1120533003:0.female: The free spirits have finally returned home.

say:4:1120529001:0.text: B-Boss... This guy is too big, we couldn't stop him!
say:4:1120529001:0.source_cn: 头儿……头儿！这家伙太大了，我们拦不住它！

say:5:1120529002:1.text: Argh, jinx that hornleaf bear for ruining our night!
say:5:1120529002:1.source_cn: 可恶，哪来的叶角熊？！净破坏我的好事！

say:6:1120529003:0.text: There weren't supposed to be any hornleaf bears in this batch of animals!
say:6:1120529003:0.source_cn: 不知道！？这批动物里没有熊！

say:9:1120529005:1.text: Those Adamant Syndicate guys are dealing with Patto! We need to seize the opportunity and deal with them quickly!
say:9:1120529005:1.source_cn: 那些黑金去对付帕托了！我们得抓紧机会，赶快解决他们才行！

narration:14:11010204:0.text: Koko suddenly cries out before Patto dashes into action, causing a great disturbance. Seize this opportunity to save the waterfowls!
narration:14:11010204:0.source_cn: 卡卡突然大声呼喊，帕托随之冲入拍卖会，把现场搅得一团乱...
